title: UC Davis on track to be carbon neutral by 2025
summary: UC Davis uses PI System, PI Vision and System Platform to optimise energy across 1,000 campus buildings, including chilled water, HVAC scheduling and a switch from district steam to low-temperature hot water.
challenge: Diverse buildings, aging infrastructure and a self-sustaining budget.
solution: Chilled water optimisation, HVAC scheduling, and conversion of district steam to low-temperature hot water.

outcomes.text: "46% reduction in energy-use intensity since 2009, a cost savings of $15 million"
"62% reduction in gas usage" from a heating system retrofit
"Expected annual savings of $150,000" from chilled water optimisation

title: Reducing electrical outages and saving up to 30% of energy expenses with AVEVA PI System
summary: The University of Maryland, College Park, with partner Data Systems Analysts, Inc., centralised its campus electrical distribution data on PI System.
challenge: Electrical distribution data was spread across disparate, isolated systems, which limited outage response.
solution: PI-centred visibility of electrical distribution data.

outcomes.text: Savings of 30% of HVAC energy expenses
Significantly reduced outage downtime (no figure given)

verifyNote: The page is inconsistent: the results section says 30% of HVAC energy expenses, while the headline says "up to 30%" of energy expenses.
